summary: Installing no longer creates a mailbox or gives the installing account an Exchange role.

fixes.title: Mail sender is set up separately
fixes.text: The installation no longer creates a mailbox, and the installing account gets no Exchange role.
fixes.action: Have your Exchange administrator set up mail under Get Started > Mail sender.

fixes.title: Hybrid worker removal keeps shared servers
fixes.text: Removing the hybrid worker leaves the server standing when another product's worker runs on it, and removes only PIM Manager's own part.
